errors.title: Something went wrong

errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING: Your workspace could not be identified. Please sign in again.
errors.CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS: This record belongs to a different workspace.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different details. Please start again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This can't be done at the current stage.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.TENANT_UNAVAILABLE: This account is currently unavailable. Please contact your distributor.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link or code has expired or was already used. Please start again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Two-step verification is required for your account and can't be turned off.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code is wrong or has expired. Please ask for a new code.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan's limit has been reached. Please contact the platform team to upgrade.
errors.LAST_OWNER: Every business needs at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.ALREADY_A_MEMBER: This person is already on your team.

errors.IMPERSONATION_BLOCKED: This can't be done in a support session, even in act mode.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.IN_USE: This is still in use, so it can't be deleted.
errors.CATEGORY_TOO_DEEP: Categories can be at most 3 levels deep.
errors.TAX_RATE_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only a GST change that hasn't started yet can be cancelled.
errors.PREVIEW_OUT_OF_DATE: The matching products changed since the preview. Preview again before confirming.
errors.RETAILER_ON_HOLD: Your account is on hold. Please contact your distributor.
errors.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: This product can't be sold right now.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Tokens and shared components used across the platform, in every state.
designSystem.brandHint: Tenants set one colour; the full scale is derived automatically.
designSystem.sampleBody: Body text is set in one family with a clear hierarchy.

impersonation.actingAs: Support session: acting as {name} (every change is recorded)
impersonation.minutesLeft: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left
impersonation.actBody: Changes are recorded in the business's audit log with your name. Passwords, two-step verification, staff and bank details can't be changed in a support session.

registration_type.label: GST registration type
registration_type.description: Your GST registration type. Only regular registration is supported now.

prices_include_gst.label: Prices include GST
prices_include_gst.description: Turn on if the prices you enter already include GST.

component_rounding.label: Rounding of tax amounts
component_rounding.description: How each tax amount is rounded to the paisa.

hsn_min_digits.label: Minimum HSN code length
hsn_min_digits.description: Minimum HSN code length required on products.

timing.label: When to create the tax invoice
timing.description: When the tax invoice is created: when goods are dispatched (for the packed quantity), or when the order or backorder is accepted.

round_to_rupee.label: Round invoice totals to the rupee
round_to_rupee.description: Round invoice totals to the nearest rupee with a round-off line.

round_off_method.label: How to round to the rupee
round_off_method.description: How the invoice total is rounded to the rupee.

default_payment_terms_days.label: Default credit days
default_payment_terms_days.description: Default credit days for new retailers (each retailer can differ).

acceptance_mode.label: Order acceptance
acceptance_mode.description: Accept new orders yourself, or automatically when they pass all checks.

send_confirmation_on_accept.label: Send Order Confirmation on acceptance
send_confirmation_on_accept.description: Send the retailer an Order Confirmation (items, prices, tax estimate) when you accept an order.

min_order_value.label: Minimum order value
min_order_value.description: Smallest order value a retailer can place. Backordered items count.

min_order_value_basis.label: Minimum order value includes GST?
min_order_value_basis.description: Whether the minimum order value includes GST.

pre_acceptance_edit_mode.label: Changes before acceptance
pre_acceptance_edit_mode.description: What your team can change before accepting: only reduce or remove items, or also add items and increase quantities. The retailer is always notified.

options.FULL_EDIT: Also add items and increase quantities

staff_can_place_on_behalf.label: Staff can order for retailers
staff_can_place_on_behalf.description: Allow your staff (for example salesmen) to place orders for retailers.

sales_visibility.label: What sales staff can see
sales_visibility.description: Which orders and retailers sales staff can see.

pending_alert_hours.label: Alert for orders waiting (hours)
pending_alert_hours.description: Show a dashboard alert for orders not accepted within this many hours.

insufficient_stock_action.label: When stock runs short (backorders off)
insufficient_stock_action.description: When backorders are off and stock runs short at checkout: stop the order and show what's short, or place only the in-stock part.

options.FAIL: Stop the order and show what's short

show_exact_quantity.label: Show exact stock to retailers
show_exact_quantity.description: Show retailers the exact quantity in stock (otherwise only "In stock" or "Low stock").

show_low_stock_label.label: Show a "Low stock" label
show_low_stock_label.description: Show a "Low stock" label to retailers when stock is at or below the reorder level.

enabled.label: Allow backorders
enabled.description: Let retailers order more than is in stock; the rest is sent when stock arrives.

allocation_mode.label: Allocating arriving stock to backorders
allocation_mode.description: When stock arrives, confirm each backorder allocation yourself, or allocate automatically (oldest orders first).

billing_price.label: Price for backordered items
billing_price.description: Price for backordered items sent later: the price when ordered, or today's price.

breach_action.label: When a credit limit would be exceeded
breach_action.description: When an order would exceed a retailer's credit limit: hold it for approval, or refuse it.

hold_reserves_stock.label: Reserve stock for orders on credit hold
hold_reserves_stock.description: Keep stock reserved for orders waiting for credit approval.

block_overdue_after_days.label: Treat as over limit when overdue by (days)
block_overdue_after_days.description: Treat a retailer as over limit when any invoice is overdue by more than this many days.

hold_advances.label: Keep extra payments as credit
hold_advances.description: Keep extra money paid by a retailer as credit and use it for their next invoices.

cheque_credit_timing.label: When a cheque counts as paid
cheque_credit_timing.description: Credit a cheque to the retailer's account when received (reversed automatically if it bounces) or only when it clears.

require_staff_2fa.label: Require two-step verification for staff
require_staff_2fa.description: Require every staff member to set up two-step verification (an authenticator app) before they can sign in.

hsn_rate_hints_enabled.label: Suggest GST rates from HSN codes
hsn_rate_hints_enabled.description: Suggest GST rates from the HSN hint table on product forms and imports.

default_invoice_prefix.label: Default invoice prefix
default_invoice_prefix.description: Prefix proposed when a tenant's first invoice series is created.

impersonation_session_minutes.label: Support session length (minutes)
impersonation_session_minutes.description: Maximum length of a support impersonation session.

login_lockout_threshold.label: Failed sign-ins before locking
login_lockout_threshold.description: Consecutive failed sign-ins before an account is locked.

login_lockout_minutes.label: Lock duration (minutes)
login_lockout_minutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked.

login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per IP per minute
login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute from one IP address (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

login_rate_per_email_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per email per minute
login_rate_per_email_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute for one email address.

otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.label: Codes per phone per 10 minutes
otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.description: OTP codes that can be requested for one phone number in 10 minutes.

otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.label: Codes per IP per hour
otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.description: OTP codes that can be requested from one IP address per hour (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

password_reset_per_email_per_hour.label: Password reset emails per address per hour
password_reset_per_email_per_hour.description: Password reset emails that can be requested for one email address per hour.

otp_max_verify_attempts.label: Wrong codes allowed
otp_max_verify_attempts.description: Wrong codes allowed before an OTP stops working.

blocked_can_sign_in.label: Shops on hold can sign in
blocked_can_sign_in.description: Shops you put on hold can still sign in and see their account, but can't order. Turn off to stop them signing in.

discounts_on_special_prices.label: Discounts on special prices
discounts_on_special_prices.description: Apply discount rules on top of a shop's special prices. Turn off to treat a special price as the final price.
